channel.title: Harsh Gaur — Articles
channel.description: Notes on retrieval, recommendations and event-driven architecture.

item.title: Which number is the price?
item.description: Parsing code-mixed Hindi and Hinglish product search: disambiguating price from size, pre-computing numeric bounds, and treating the language model as a compiler rather than a chatbot.

item.title: Four signals, one score
item.description: Why a pure embedding recommender returns beautiful, useless results, and how blending vector similarity with co-occurrence, category and attribute signals fixes it.

item.title: Who gets told what
item.description: Replacing hardcoded notification triggers with a rules engine: event registries, the recipient type that resolves to nobody, and a duplicate-message bug caused by one person holding two roles.
